+++ b/mkdocs/tests/test_yaml_inherit_cycles.py
@@ -0,0 +1,56 @@
+import os
+import re
+
+import pytest
+
+from mkdocs.exceptions import ConfigurationError
+from mkdocs.utils.yaml import get_yaml_loader, yaml_load
+
+
+def load(path, loader=None):
+    with path.open("rb") as fd:
+        return yaml_load(fd, loader)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("two_files", [False, True])
+def test_inherit_cycle_has_ordered_paths(tmp_path, two_files):
+    a = tmp_path / "a.yml"
+    b = tmp_path / "b.yml"
+    a.write_text("INHERIT: b.yml\n" if two_files else "INHERIT: a.yml\n")
+    if two_files:
+        b.write_text("INHERIT: a.yml\n")
+    chain = [a, b, a] if two_files else [a, a]
+    with pytest.raises(ConfigurationError) as exc:
+        load(a)
+    message = str(exc.value)
+    assert "INHERIT" in message
+    assert re.search(".*?".join(re.escape(os.path.realpath(p)) for p in chain), message, re.S)
+
+
+def test_symlink_alias_detected_as_same_inherit_file(tmp_path):
+    a = tmp_path / "a.yml"
+    b = tmp_path / "b.yml"
+    alias = tmp_path / "alias.yml"
+    a.write_text("INHERIT: b.yml\n")
+    b.write_text("INHERIT: alias.yml\n")
+    try:
+        alias.symlink_to(a)
+    except (OSError, NotImplementedError):
+        pytest.skip("symlinks unavailable")
+    with pytest.raises(ConfigurationError) as exc:
+        load(a)
+    message = str(exc.value)
+    assert "INHERIT" in message
+    assert re.search(".*?".join(re.escape(os.path.realpath(p)) for p in [a, b, a]), message, re.S)
+
+
+def test_acyclic_inheritance_and_repeated_loads(tmp_path):
+    parent = tmp_path / "parent.yml"
+    child = tmp_path / "child.yml"
+    parent.write_text("nested:\n  parent: 1\n  override: old\n")
+    child.write_text("INHERIT: parent.yml\nnested:\n  child: 2\n  override: new\n")
+    loader = get_yaml_loader()
+    expected = {"nested": {"parent": 1, "child": 2, "override": "new"}}
+    assert load(child, loader) == expected
+    assert load(child, loader) == expected
+    assert yaml_load("INHERIT: parent.yml\nvalue: 3\n", loader) == {"INHERIT": "parent.yml", "value": 3}

The error message must contain 'INHERIT' and the cycle's filenames in traversal order, with the starting filename repeated at the end. Keep the existing yaml_load calling interface, relative resolution of inherited filenames, deep-merge precedence, custom-loader propagation, and the rule that string sources do not process INHERIT. Cycle-tracking state must not leak between independent loads. Submit a unified diff against production files only, without changing tests.
